name: Heritage_Track
description: Advanced pedigree visualization and genetic analysis plugin. Displays interactive genealogy graphs with parent-child relationships, computes kinship and inbreeding coefficients, supports heritage-only animal creation, and provides intelligent layout optimization. Features include force-directed positioning, edge bundling, viewport-based rendering for large datasets, engine caching for performance, draggable nodes, genotype annotations with color legends, species filtering, and family node collapsing.

performance_features.engine_caching: Intelligent PedigreeEngine caching with automatic invalidation (3-5x speedup)
performance_features.fast_level_computation: Kahn's algorithm for O(V+E) level computation vs O(V²)
performance_features.viewport_culling: Only renders visible nodes for large datasets (1000+ animals)
performance_features.batch_persistence: Deferred disk writes for improved responsiveness

layout_features.force_directed_layout: Physics-based overlap resolution with pedigree constraints
layout_features.edge_bundling: Groups parallel edges to reduce visual clutter
layout_features.adaptive_spacing: Dynamic spacing based on label lengths
